# sonarqube_group (Data Source)

Reads a group by its exact name, including a built-in group. The alpha supports SonarQube Cloud only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_group" "members" {
  organization = "my-organization"
  name         = "Members"
}

output "members_group_id" {
  value = data.sonarqube_group.members.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact group name.
- `organization` (String) Key of the organization that owns the group.

### Read-Only

- `built_in` (Boolean) Whether SonarQube Cloud made the group for the organization, as for Members.
- `description` (String) Group description.
- `id` (String) Opaque group identifier.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether an identity provider synchronizes the group through SCIM.
